normative_inputs.supersession: Amendment 001 controls on conflict; otherwise profile and wire remain normative.

oracle_classes.PARSE_REJECT: subject is outside the exact MFST v1 grammar or contains an explicitly absent capability; both verifiers must reject before semantic authority
oracle_classes.SEMANTIC_REJECT: subject parses but exact finite semantics, closure, termination, domain, table totality, or ALLOW obligations fail
oracle_classes.CROSSCHECK_REJECT: a producer/refinement/downstream assertion may exist, but independent reconstruction or crossed replay must disagree and positive authority is forbidden
oracle_classes.ACCEPT: both independent direct semantics and crossed C2 replay agree and downstream W5/W6 accept; this class is only an expected future test oracle, not current authority

anti_gaming_rules: A vector is not credited as testing refinement if it is accidentally killed earlier by an unrelated malformed fixture unless its oracle class explicitly permits that stage.
Producer-supplied reachability, REALIZE, target, completeness, mapping, or verdict fields are never substituted for direct reconstruction.
A checker-specific exception, crash, timeout, skipped test, xfail, or harness parse error is not a PASS.
Any W7/W8 disagreement is CROSSCHECK_REJECT even if one side says ACCEPT.
Any direct-C3 versus generated-C2 trace disagreement is CROSSCHECK_REJECT before K1 preservation can be considered.
Any mutation that changes exact subject bytes must change c3src identity; semantic-equivalent representation mutations may preserve c3sem only where the wire explicitly canonicalizes them.
Forbidden-effect vectors must be killed because the faithful forbidden consequence survives to K1 or because fidelity fails, never because the harness silently removes the effect.
Nontermination is established by repeated exact configuration, not by arbitrary producer gas. Prefix effects from a nonterminating run never create positive closure authority.

baseline_oracle.expected_result: ACCEPT after W7/W8 crossed reconstruction and W5/W6 downstream revalidation
required_properties: state table update executes before branch
full multi-effect order preserved in C3 trace
K1 projection deduplicates only after trace fidelity is established
both worlds receive identical relation for this baseline

positive_controls.name: representation_permutation
positive_controls.construction: permute JSON object keys, world order, state/table/block declaration order, table row order only; do not change operation order, table argument order, row tuple positions, or effect order

positive_controls.name: multi_effect_allowed
positive_controls.construction: baseline alt path retains ordered payloads 02 then 03

positive_controls.name: finite_state_terminating_loop
positive_controls.construction: add a two-state loop whose exact configuration sequence terminates before repetition and emits only allowed payloads
positive_controls.must_demonstrate: visited-configuration criterion does not reject merely because a block label repeats with different state

positive_controls.name: world_as_explicit_input
positive_controls.construction: use @world as an input source with exact world-domain-compatible receiving/formal domain

positive_controls.name: open_universe_allowed_payload
positive_controls.construction: emit exact payload aa, whose consequence identity is derived by the C2 consequence hash and is explicitly ALLOWed

positive_controls.name: apply_table_alias_prestate
positive_controls.construction: APPLY_TABLE uses dst state cell as an argument; lookup reads pre-operation value and writes once afterward

positive_controls.name: declared_unreachable_block
positive_controls.construction: add a syntactically valid unreachable block containing only profile-valid operations; c3sem/source identity changes, reachable graph/trace/C2 behavior do not

implementation_independence_requirements: W7 and W8 must be independently implemented in different languages and may share protocol files/fixtures but no parser, executor, canonicalizer, graph builder, trace builder, normalizer, or checker code.
Each verifier must independently compute c3src, c3sem, reachable graph, ordered trace map, K1 projected relation, canonical C2 program bytes, C2 boundary, and exact derived C2 gas.
Crossed replay is mandatory: W7-generated C2 is replayed against W8 direct trace and W8-generated C2 against W7 direct trace before downstream W5/W6 acceptance can count.

A fixed known-answer test with frozen literal commitment constants must be added after independent implementations exist; those constants may not be generated at test runtime by either checker under test.
promotion_rule: F0 is only a frozen prospective oracle corpus. C3 may not be called qualified until all 62 frozen oracles have the required outcome, all static/differential/generative gates pass on hosted CI, exact fixture and normative blob integrity is verified, W7/W8 remain implementation-independent, W5/W6 independently revalidate generated C2 evidence, and a final qualification manifest pins the exact science anchor and tooling blobs.
forbidden_repairs: do not weaken an oracle after seeing a checker failure
do not change a fixture to match an implementation unless a new explicit pre-authority amendment records why the old oracle was semantically wrong
do not credit parser rejection for a vector whose frozen oracle requires semantic or cross-check detection
do not canonicalize away operation/effect order
do not add producer gas to avoid exact cycle detection
do not widen MFST with ambient capabilities for convenience
do not infer native-code preservation from MFST preservation
do not modify C2 or K1 semantics to make C3 pass
